# Ring of Water Walking (`magic-items:ring-of-water-walking`)
**Category:** [Rings](../equipment-categories/rings.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** No

Ring

While wearing this ring, you cast Water Walk from it, targeting only yourself.
